note: Where MABAYANI came from, stated on the page itself. This is hand-authored and lives apart from data/mabayani.json, which scripts/parse-mabayani-spec.py regenerates wholesale from the brief — anything added there by hand is lost on the next parse.
rules: The author is quoted, never paraphrased and never written for. `epigraph` must appear word for word inside the closing quotation card in data/mabayani-assets.json; scripts/build-mabayani.py refuses to build if it does not, so the two can never drift and no sentence can be put in her name by editing this file alone.
State what is known and nothing around it. That she wrote it and donated it is the claim; why she donated it is not recorded here and is not guessed at.

Her name appears on this page and in the closing reflection of bulletin/why-mabayani-exists.html, and nowhere else on the site. scripts/check-mabayani-anonymity.py enforces that against the built HTML.
author: Binibining Francine Marie Bautista
label: Where this comes from
title: MABAYANI is a book.
body: It was researched and written by Binibining Francine Marie Bautista, who donated the work to this initiative. What you are reading is that book.
Every chapter of it is published here with the record it rests on beside it — the sources, the evidence state of each claim, and the questions the evidence has not answered.
epigraph: MABAYANI is not finished when it is printed. It begins when a reader decides to become worthy of the history.
